name: Starlight Princess Pachi

features.name: Scatter Respin
features.description: A middle-reel scatter holds while other reels respin.

review:
A fast 3x3 Starlight Princess with 27 ways and a pachinko feel. The blue star is the top symbol.

If a princess scatter lands only on the middle reel, a Scatter Respin holds it while the other reels spin. Three scatters launch free spins, starting with a respin mini-game that sets how many you get, and scatters keep being collected during the bonus. 96.04% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
